description: The continued use of the site for open storage (Use Class B8) including vehicle storage for a period of two years (amended description)
decision_conditions: The use hereby permitted shall cease on or before the date falling two years after the date of this planning permission. On or before that date, all cars and shipping containers stored on the site pursuant to this permission, together with any temporary ancillary structures installed pursuant to this permission, shall be removed from the site.

Reason: The application has been assessed as a temporary use of previously developed land pending its anticipated longer-term redevelopment. A temporary permission is necessary to ensure that the use does not prejudice the future comprehensive redevelopment of the site. The condition is imposed having regard to NPPF 2026 Policies L2 and E2, London Plan Policies E4 and E7, and Havering Local Plan Policies 19 and 20.
The use hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:
·	Proposed Heights Zoning Plan Rev-P00 dated 27th March 2023

Reason: To ensure that the development is carried out in accordance with the approved details and to provide certainty regarding the layout and extent of the permitted use, in the interests of visual amenity, neighbouring amenity and the character of the area. The condition is imposed having regard to NPPF 2026 Policy DP3, London Plan Policies D3 and D4, and Havering Local Plan Policies 26 and 27.
The site shall be used solely for the open storage of cars and shipping containers and construction equipment.

Reason: To control the nature, extent and height of the storage use in the interests of visual amenity, the character and appearance of the area, the setting and openness of the adjoining Metropolitan Green Belt, and the amenity of neighbouring occupiers. The condition is imposed having regard to NPPF 2026 Policy DP3, London Plan Policies D3 and D4, and Havering Local Plan Policies 7, 26, 27 and 34.
The shipping containers shall be arranged and limited in height as per the approved Proposed Heights Zoning Plan Rev-P00 dated 27th March 2023.
Reason: In the interest of visual amenity and neighbouring amenity.

The use hereby permitted shall operate only between 07:00 and 18:00 Monday to Friday and between 08:00 and 13:00 on Saturdays. There shall be no operation of the site on Sundays or Bank/Public Holidays.

Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring residential occupiers by limiting noise and disturbance associated with the operation of the site. The condition is imposed having regard to London Plan Policies D13 and D14 and Havering Local Plan Policies 7 and 34.

With the exception of emergency lighting, no external lighting, including floodlighting, shall be installed or operated on the site unless details of the proposed lighting have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall include the location, type, height, direction, intensity, colour temperature and hours of operation of the lighting, together with measures to minimise light spill onto neighbouring residential properties and the adjoining Site of Importance for Nature Conservation. Any lighting subsequently installed shall be operated and maintained in accordance with the approved details. No additional or replacement external lighting shall be installed or operated without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To prevent unacceptable light pollution and protect the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers and the ecological interests of the adjoining Site of Importance for Nature Cons

This permission authorises only the temporary use and storage described in the decision notice and shown on the approved plans. It does not grant permission for the site's longer-term redevelopment or for any separate operational development that may require planning permission.
